review.posthog_relevance: Changes MotherDuck warehouse source error handling and connection failure behavior, potentially affecting retry behavior and user-facing error messages.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded change to MotherDuck warehouse source error handling. P1.F2.H3 removes a generic DuckDB error class and adds a MotherDuck-specific entry for 'Invalid Input Error', while P1.F2.H4 adds a test asserting connection failures are treated as non-retryable. This could affect retry behavior and user-facing error messages for MotherDuck users. P
